Thank you. As you've heard from some colleagues already, today we again confront a familiar pattern from this administration—vetoes that ignore the realities facing working class New Yorkers that undermine the clear decision and veto-proof majority these bills passed within this council. With mere

NEW YORK CITY COUNCIL STATED MEETING 50 weeks left in office, the Mayor has once again chosen obstruction over collaboration, rejecting bills that strengthen pay equity, keeping low-income tenants from being rent burdened, and finally bringing long overdue accountability to a contracting system that routinely leaves nonprofits waiting months to be paid for critical work. Our responsibility is not to protect any mayor's legacy. It is to protect New Yorkers. These bills passed with overwhelming support because they address real needs in every district represented in this chamber. And for that reason, I vote aye to override these vetoes. Thank you.
